rows.text: It is quiet and peaceful inside the cave. The groups of insects jumping in the air look like colorful stars in the sky. A lady with a gray-matter-esque complexion is sleeping in the cave with noblesse worms crawling at her feet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: When she opens her eyes and sees you, a colorful flame instantly materializes next to her, spreads along the wall, and soon reaches your feet. You're surrounded by fire in an instant.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Waves of memories gush into your mind, overloading your psyche. You recall the afternoon when you counted with your fingers for the first time in your life, and the first time you saw space ants walking in a straight line. Why do you remember these?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Remembering the trash makes you feel alive." You catch her letting out an icy snort. "Worship {RUBY_B#Aeon of Remembrance} Fuli{RUBY_E#}, and we will burn your dull memories." She says.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
